name: @raea/blender
description: Blender's Python API from TypeScript (docs/blender.feature): bpy, bmesh, mathutils, bpy_extras and gpu, typed from Blender's own API (tools/gen.sh), run in a headless Blender, the person's own (live), or the one `raea blender run` starts. mathutils is computed locally with Blender's maths.
